Package com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.abc

Class ScriptPack

java.lang.Object
com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.treeitems.AS3ClassTreeItem
com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.abc.ScriptPack
All Implemented Interfaces:
TreeItem
public class ScriptPack extends AS3ClassTreeItem
Script pack class. A script pack is a collection of traits that are in the same script. It can be a simple script pack (contains only one externally visible definition) or a compound script pack (contains more than one externally visible definitions).
Author:
JPEXS
